# pdfdol

> Data Object Layer for PDF data


## Pages in this subsection

- [pdfdol](pdfdol.html.md): Data Object Layers for PDF data.
- [pdfdol.base](pdfdol.base.html.md): Base objects for pdfdol
- [pdfdol.bundle](pdfdol.bundle.html.md): Bundle several PDFs into one, with a contents page, per-document headers and bookmarks.
- [pdfdol.checks](pdfdol.checks.html.md): Checks that verify a PDF, rather than looking at a few of its pages.
- [pdfdol.chromium](pdfdol.chromium.html.md): Headless Chromium engine: print web pages designed for the screen.
- [pdfdol.download](pdfdol.download.html.md): Download PDF articles from markdown-formatted text.
- [pdfdol.figures](pdfdol.figures.html.md): Crop a figure or table out of a PDF by its caption, and locate a quoted passage.
- [pdfdol.tools](pdfdol.tools.html.md): | &#96;add_css&#96;(html_text&#91;, css&#93;)                                                                       ...
- [pdfdol.util](pdfdol.util.html.md): Utils for pdfdol
